That's just what I hoped for. I pasted the address, hit Save link, and it filled in the title "JavaScript | MDN" and a little description on its own, plus it shows where it came from. That's exactly the "paste and it does the work for me" feeling I wanted.

And yes, both of those choices feel right:

- New links starting as **To read** makes sense to me — most things I save are things I mean to get to, so that's a good default.
- Having the collection sit right below the paste box is nice and simple. I paste at the top, and there it is underneath.

So this flow is good. Just so I know it's on your radar for later — I'll eventually want to actually mark something as done once I've read it, and I'll want to add my own labels — but I don't need to see those right now. For what you're showing me here, this is right.
